questions.question: The speed of a boat in still water is 8 km/h. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, then how much distance can be boat travel in two hours going upstream?
questions.solution:
Speed of a boat in still water = 8 km/h

The speed of stream = 2 km/h

Speed of a boat in upstream = 8 – 2 = 6 km/h

Distance = speed × time = 6 × 2 = 12 km

∴ The boat can travel 12 km in two hours.

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are 15 cm, 12 cm and 11 cm respectively. The length is decreased by 6(2)/(3)%%, the breadth increased by 8(1)/(3)%%, whereas the height is kept unchanged. What is the change in the total area of the four side faces (considering the rectangle contained by the length and breadth as the base) of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length = 15 cm, Breadth = 12 cm, Height = 11 cm

**Formula used:**

The total area of the four side faces of cuboid = 2h(l + b)

**Calculation:**

The total area of the four side faces of cuboid

⇒ 2 × 11 × (15 + 12) = 22 × 27 = 594 cm²

Now, converting percentage to fraction to make calculation easy

{{}}6(2)/(3)\% = (1)/({15)} , 8(1)/(3)\% {{}} = {{}}(1)/({12)} 

Length after decrease

⇒ 15 × (1 - 1/15) = 15 × 14/15 = 14 cm

Breadth after increase

⇒ 12 × (1 + 1/12) = 12 × 13/12 = 13 cm

Height (no change) = 11 cm

⇒ The total area of the four side faces after change in length and breadth = 2 × 11(14 + 13)

⇒ The total area of the four side faces after change in length and breadth = 594 cm²

⇒ Change in total area = 594 – 594 = 0

**∴ No change in the total area of the four side faces.**

questions.question: A car can travel a distance of 300 meters in 6 minutes. What is its average speed in km/h?
questions.solution:
Distance = 300 meters = 0.3 km

⇒ Time = 6 minutes = 0.1 hour

⇒ Speed = distance/ time = 0.3/0.1 = 3 km/h

∴ The average speed of car is 3 in km/h.

questions.question: The average weight of 8 gold coins is 20 g per coin. The average weight of 12 silver coins is 35 g per coin. What is the average weight per coin for 20 coins?
questions.solution:
Average weight = Total weight/Number of coins

⇒ The average weight of 8 gold coins = 20 g

⇒ Total weight of 8 coins = 160 g

⇒ The average weight of 12 silver coins = 35 g

⇒ Total weight of 12 silver coins = 420 g

⇒ The average weight for 20 coins = (160 + 420)/(8 + 12)

⇒ The average weight for 20 coins = 580/20 = 29 g

∴ The average weight is 29 g per coin for 20 coins.

questions.question: If U + V = 80 and U : V = 5 : 3, then what is the value of U – V?
questions.solution:
Let the value of U and V be 5x and 3x

⇒ Given, U + V = 80

⇒ 5x + 3x = 80

⇒ 8x = 80

⇒ x = 10

⇒ U – V = 5x – 3x = 2x = 20

∴ The value of U – V is 20.

questions.question: A man spends 10% of his salary on food. He spends 20% of the remaining part on fuel. If he is left with Rs. 4680, then what is his salary?
questions.solution:
Spend on food = 10%

⇒ Spend on fuel = (100 – 10) × 20% = 18%

⇒ Remaining salary of man = 100% – (10 + 18)% = 72%

⇒ 72% → Rs. 4680

⇒ 100% → Rs. 6500

∴ His salary is Rs. 6500.

questions.question: If x + y + z = 400 and x : y : z = 1 : 1 : 2, then what is the value of z?
questions.solution:
Let the value of x, y and z be a, a, and 2a

⇒ x + y + z = 400 [Given]

⇒ a + a + 2a = 400

⇒ a = 100

⇒ The value of z = 2a = 200

∴ The value of z is 200.

questions.question: Average of 49, 62, 37, 55 and x is 53. What is the value of x?
questions.solution:
Average = Sum of number/number of term

⇒ 53 = (49 + 62 + 37 + 55 + x)/5

⇒ 265 = 203 + x

⇒ x = 62

∴ The value of x is 62.

questions.question: The median date of the year 2019 written as DD.MM is:
questions.solution:
Median = (Odd terms + 1)/2

⇒ Total days in 2019 = 365

⇒ Median days = (365 + 1)/2 = 183

⇒ Number of days (1 January to 30 June) = 181 days

⇒ Median date = 2 July 2019

∴ The median date of the year 2019 written as DD.MM is 02.07

questions.question: An article is sold for Rs. 1725 at 15% profit. If it is sold at 15% loss, then what will be the selling price?
questions.solution:
Selling price = Rs. 1725, Profit = 15%

⇒ Selling price = cost price × (100 + profit)%

⇒ 1725 = cost price × 115%

⇒ Cost price = 1500

⇒ If loss = 15%

⇒ Selling price = cost price × (100 – loss)%

⇒ Selling price = 1500 × 85%

⇒ Selling price = Rs. 1275

∴ The selling price will be Rs. 1275.

questions.question: If after two years a sum becomes Rs. 4000 and after four years it becomes Rs. 6000 at the same rate of compound interest (compounded annually), then what is the sum?
questions.solution:
**Formula Used:**

For compound interest,

A = P (1 + r/100)t

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal

r = Rate, t = Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ 4000 = P(1 + r/100)² ---- (1)

⇒ 6000 = P (1 + r/100)⁴ ---- (2)

From (2) /(1),

⇒ 3/2 = (1 + r/100)²

From (1)

⇒ 4000 = P × 3/2

⇒ P = 8000/3 = Rs. 2666.66

**∴ The sum is Rs. 2666.66**

questions.question: The difference in selling price of article for selling at 25% profit and 37.5% loss is Rs. 1250. What will be selling price when it is sold at 12.5% profit?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price of an article be 100x.

⇒ Selling price at 25% profit = 100x × (100 + 25)% = 125x

⇒ Selling price at 37.5% loss = 100x × (100 – 37.5)% = 62.5x

⇒ The difference in selling price of article for selling at 25% profit and 37.5% loss = 125x – 62.5x

⇒ 1250 = 62.5x

⇒ x = 20

⇒ The cost price of the article = 100x = Rs. 2000

If profit 12.5%

⇒ Selling price = 2000 × (100 + 12.5)% = Rs. 2250

∴ Selling price when it is sold at 12.5% profit will be Rs. 2250.
